note: TD6's footprint annotations: our own measurements of TD2's kit pieces, keyed by vendor GUID (FootprintMeasurer.cs, `demo3d unity MeasureFootprints`). Ground (x, y) is Unity's (x, z) in the prefab's own frame at scale 1. A footprint is the convex hull of the colliders (else the meshes) cut 1 m above the ground: a circle when its minimum-area rectangle's aspect is under 1.35, else that rectangle. Pieces under 0.5 m tall, under 0.15 m in equivalent radius, or soft (grass, flowers, ferns, small rocks, candles) do not block. canopyRadiusM is the widest reach of any mesh from the origin, which the layout keeps off fighting ground.
